preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 30.

preconditions.expression: for each test case: 1 <= n <= 100 and 1 <= m <= 30
preconditions.description: For each test case, n is between 1 and 100, and m is between 1 and 30.

preconditions.expression: for each test case: for each i in range(m): 1 <= vi <= n and all(0 <= x < n for x in Si)
preconditions.description: For each test case, each set Si has a size vi between 1 and n, and all elements of Si are between 0 and n-1.

preconditions.expression: for each test case: all(x in union(Si for i in range(m)) for x in range(n))
preconditions.description: For each test case, every number between 0 and n-1 appears in at least one set Si.

postconditions.expression: for each test case: output is a single integer k
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is a single integer k representing the minimum number of atoms.

postconditions.expression: for each test case: k is the minimum number of atoms such that every item in X is in some Ai and no two Ai, Aj with i ≠ j share a common item
postconditions.description: For each test case, k is the minimum number of atoms that partition X according to the given constraints.
